dedupe_keys.name: adaptive learning of inland ship power propulsion under environmental disturbances

description: Nicolas Dann and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The implemented model combines engine dynamics and one-degree-of-freedom vessel manoeuvring, accounting for water-depth effects on power demand. Analytical ship resistance is supplemented by an error-filtering online-learning approximation of unmodelled wind/air resistance. Coverage is the inland-vessel simulation under several weather conditions. The source reports successful estimation of the unmodelled component; it does not establish measured fleet-wide prediction accuracy. Source code, trained parameters and exact environmental time series are unknown. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
